title: mapania sumatrana subsp. pandanophylla
intro: Mapania sumatrana subsp. pandanophylla, commonly known as Pandan Mapania, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pandan Mapania are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may exhibit antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular-protective effects. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy of Pandan Mapania for various health applications, but its bioactive constituents hold promise for potential therapeutic uses.
